confidence_notes: Aggregated San Francisco price indexes place cappuccino near $6, draft beer around $8–9, inexpensive meals around $18–25, and a three-course meal for two around $122–128. Cocktail estimates are around $17; wine is estimated from its relationship to local draft beer because glass-specific averages were sparse. Accommodation is a holistic summer estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used for food and drink. Accommodation reflects a high-cost US coastal city in summer, with an allowance for San Francisco demand.
